intro: Settle into Ohio after a long day and let it carry your weight. With soft leather touchpoints, a smooth rocking recline, and a quiet manual mechanism, it turns small pauses into unhurried comfort.

features.title: Recline that flows with you
features.text: A noiseless manual mechanism lets you lean back at your pace, unfolding the footrest smoothly so relaxation feels effortless and unbroken.

features.title: Rocking motion for gentle ease
features.text: The built-in rocking function calms your body and mind, making quick breaks or long naps feel restorative and natural.

features.title: Leather touch where it matters
features.text: Pigmented leather at contact points feels premium and ages beautifully, while synthetic leather elsewhere keeps care simple and fuss-free.

features.title: Cushioned for all-day comfort
features.text: High-density slab foam in seat, back, and arms creates a floating softness, balanced by support that lets you sink in without losing posture.

features.title: Built for durability inside out
features.text: A frame of moisture-resistant plywood and pinewood paired with powder-coated mild steel linkages ensures lasting strength through daily use.

features.title: Armrests made for real rest
features.text: Folded foam-padded arms give your elbows and wrists a natural landing spot, adding comfort across every posture.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Ohio Manual 1-Seater Pigmented And Synthetic Leather Rocker Recliner
